question: Which specific divisions are included under the divisions of Tārā?
premises: The text refers to divisions of Tārā.
These divisions are specified by name.
The named divisions are Ugra-tārā, Ekajaṭā, and Nīla-sarasvatī.
inference: The divisions of Tārā are Ugra-tārā, Ekajaṭā, and Nīla-sarasvatī.
plain_english: By the divisions of Tārā are meant the divisions of Ugra-tārā, Ekajaṭā, and Nīla-sarasvatī.
